# Technical Summary of the Strata Project

Strata is an inference engine for the **Qwen3.8-Flash-Next** 125-billion-parameter MoE model, designed to run on consumer hardware (a single NVIDIA RTX 30/40/50 series GPU with 12 GB VRAM plus 64 GB system RAM). The architecture partitions the model across three memory tiers—GPU VRAM, pinned host RAM, and SSD—so that attention layers, gated-residual (hyper-connection) weights, the KV cache, and the most frequently routed experts reside on the GPU, while the full set of 24,576 experts is held in RAM and computed by the CPU concurrently with GPU work. The project's benchmark data reports 46–95 tokens/s output on an RTX 5070
